definitions.explanation: the gradual destruction or degradation of materials (especially metals) by chemical reaction

examples.japanese: ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{腐食|ふしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{腐食|ふしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To paint in order to prevent corrosion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配管|はいかん}→配管：07495_haikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腐食|ふしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Corrosion of the pipes is advancing.

notes:
{腐食|ふしょく} refers to the chemical degradation of materials.

WRITING:
- {腐|ふ} (rot, decay, corrode)
- {食|しょく} (eat, erode)

TYPES OF CORROSION:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{腐食|ふしょく}/{電食|でんしょく} (electrolytic corrosion)
- ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧{腐食|ふしょく} (chemical corrosion)
- {応力|おうりょく}{腐食|ふしょく} (stress corrosion)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腐食|ふしょく}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (corrosion prevention)
- {腐食|ふしょく}{性|せい} (corrosive property)
- {耐|たい}{腐食|ふしょく}{性|せい} (corrosion resistance)
- {腐食|ふしょく}{剤|ざい} (corrosive agent)

USAGE:
- {腐食|ふしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to corrode - suru verb)
- {腐食|ふしょく}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to cause corrosion)
